invariants.rule: Coverage family is not a narrative instance.
Cross-surah convergence does not establish scene identity.
A promoted child must retain parent or family lineage.
A permanent NAR-ID must be globally unique and sequentially allocated.
A local instance must be bounded before identity comparison.
Parallel retellings retain local identity unless a later exact identity test proves otherwise.
Provenance containers are retained and are not counted as new local scenes.
Family IDs, local-instance IDs, and narrative IDs are different identifier domains.
No Batch 004 record may bypass BF-R01 through BF-R06, PNIE when distributed, and E09.
Any future regression failure reopens the calibration gate before further promotion.
